spans.text: Mlanaa lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hegbɛ akɛ akɛ woo haa lɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ adesa.
Mlanaa lɛ mɛi fɛɛ yeɔ egbɔ, ni esa akɛ akwɛ koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ afee shweshweeshwe bɔ ni hiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ ko kwraa bɛ mli.

spans.text: Esaaa akɛ amɔɔ mɔ ko, aloo atsiɔ enaa, aloo atswaa enaneshi tu kɛji aboteko sane ko ni akɛshi lɛ mli jogbaŋŋ.

spans.text: Asaŋ akwɛ koni akajie niiaŋ bɔ ni akɛ mɔ ko maŋ ni ejɛ lɛ agbojee miitsu nii yɛ hegbɛi nɛɛ agbɛfaŋ, kɛji maŋ lɛ ena heyeli jio, aajɛ maŋ kroko nɔ aakwɛ esaji anɔ jio, enako heyeli jio, aloo ehɔ nɔyeli ko shishi fã kɛ fã.

spans.text: Esaaa akɛ akwɛɔ hiɛiaŋ yɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛfaŋ kɛji aye lɛ sane ko ni kɛ kpaŋmɔ nɛɛ kpãaa, aloo awo yiŋ koni afee nɔ ko ni kpaŋmɔ nɛɛ eŋmɛɛɛ he gnɛ.

spans.text: Gbɔmɛi fɛɛ yɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ henilee, ni no hewɔ lɛ esa akɛ amɛhe ahi shi yɛ nyɛmi suɔmɔ mli.

spans.text: Akɛni aŋɔɔ nɔ akɛ afɔ gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ akɛ mɛi ni yeɔ egbɔ kɛ heyeli ko ni anyɛŋ ashɔ̃ yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni nomɛi ji heyeli, jalɛsane kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ shishifãi yɛ je lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ,
